verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents a public developer API: an Agent API with web-grounded answers, citations and multi-turn context, plus a Search API, embeddings, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, structured output, model fallback and reusable profiles. Probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json and an llms.txt index for the API docs. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API in practice.
